<\STATESEP>chapter "Threads"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory ArchThread_H
imports
  ArchThreadDecls_H
  TCBDecls_H
  ArchVSpaceDecls_H
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context Arch begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>global_naming ARM_H<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs switchToThread_def:
"switchToThread tcb\<equiv> (do
    setVMRoot tcb;
    doMachineOp $ ARM.clearExMonitor
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs configureIdleThread_def:
"configureIdleThread tcb\<equiv> (
    doKernelOp $ asUser tcb $ (do
        setRegister (Register CPSR) 0x1f;
        setRegister (Register NextIP) $ fromVPtr idleThreadStart
    od)
)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs switchToIdleThread_def:
"switchToIdleThread\<equiv> (do
   t \<leftarrow> getIdleThread;
   setVMRoot t
od)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>defs activateIdleThread_def:
"activateIdleThread arg1 \<equiv> return ()"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
